rationale: Build on the current two-block tail-recurrence winner without adding parameters or export bytes. The repeated tail blocks now reuse their own first-pass inputs as the residual anchor on the recurrent pass instead of the original token-embedding anchor, so the learned resid_mix in those blocks refines an already-deep state rather than being pulled back toward shallow features. This is a minimal recurrent-depth transplant that preserves the current FP16 QKV rescue, quant-aware endgame, exact int8+zlib evaluation path, and Mac-mini compile stability.
title: First-Pass Anchored Tail Recurrence
